def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    color = next(x for x in counts if x != bg)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The object is built from a repeating two-row/two-column motif.
    # Continue the motif into the blank tail of each row, marking the
    # positions that correspond to the non-background cells of the motif.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        last = max((c for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == color), default=-1)
        if last < 0:
            continue
        for c in range(last + 1, w):
            # Use the observed pattern in the same row as a cyclic template.
            p = None
            for period in range(1, min(last + 1, 12) + 1):
                if all(row[i] == row[i-period] for i in range(period, last + 1)):
                    p = period
                    break
            if p and row[c-p] == color and row[c] == bg:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
